_comment: Release 1 task addendum (owner-approved 2026-10-14, ADR docs/adr/0004-small-task-specific-models.md). spec/tasks.json stays the frozen 300-task source for tools/r1_handoff.py; this file is the contract. Denominator: 304.
title: Sequence-classification-head training (seq_cls_lora; owner-approved integration-form change)
security: Same training-worker boundary as FTF-R003: mirrored/local model+tokenizer only, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, trust_remote_code false, no hub push, no external report_to callbacks, AXOLOTL_DO_NOT_TRACK/DO_NOT_TRACK/HF telemetry off, network denied; no final-suite mount; tenant-scoped artifact prefix.
observability: Content-free metrics only: loss, per-class counts, macro-F1/per-class recall on validation, grad norm, step timings; no text, labels-with-text or record ids in logs.
resource_gate: Real GPU (gpu_driver currently BLOCKED_EXTERNAL) for the qualified run; a CPU run on a locally constructed tiny encoder proves mechanics only and is labelled so. Unavailable required evidence is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, never skipped.
database_changes: None: method value seq_cls_lora lives in FTF-0701's training-config schema (reserved there), label map and head config live in the signed artifact manifest (FTF-1002 lineage). If a table proves necessary it gets ENABLE+FORCE RLS tenant_isolation, no DELETE for sovra_app, data_exposure_check and a cross-tenant test.
api_contract: TrainingJobSpec(method=seq_cls_lora, label_set, step_binding_key) -> EngineRunReceipt / verified checkpoint and merged classifier artifact; no public training service invented.
acceptance: From an approved immutable train/validation split, render (input, label) pairs from canonical records whose supervised target is a member of the step's declared label set, train a PEFT SEQ_CLS adapter plus head on AutoModelForSequenceClassification under the FTF-R003 supervisor, with real gradients updating only adapter and head tensors, validation-only early stopping, and package a merged, hash-verified classifier artifact (weights, config with id2label/label2id, tokenizer, label-set hash, base digest, dataset hashes, config hash, library tuple) that reloads and reproduces validation predictions.
Independent review, exact merged commit, real relevant integration and negative-test evidence recorded.
negative_acceptance: A target outside the label set, label-map/num_labels mismatch, frozen-base update, nonfinite loss, single-class or empty-class training split, final-suite or development-suite source, remote model download or trust_remote_code requirement fails the run; seq_cls_lora is never a silent fallback for a chat LoRA job, and no library outside the pinned compatibility tuple is loaded.
